purpose: Transparent deliberately incomplete control on the exact same released portfolio; not a claim about generic agents or real manual work.
rule: Use physical stock by SKU and depot, without reservations, downstream commitments, dependencies or CRM qualification. Keep this definition fixed before execution.
limitations: This baseline is intentionally weaker than the product rules.
Its timing must be measured during this run, not copied from the earlier 2.5 second smoke.
Do not infer business gain or general superiority from synthetic comparison.

corePreEventResult.method: For each confirmed commitment compare its own quantity with total physical SKU/unit at its destination. No reservation subtraction, inbound consideration or shared consumption. Deliberately weak control, not a fair manual or LLM benchmark.
